descriptors.object: Li⁺ 溶剂化（电解液给体数，¹H NMR 法）
descriptors.scale: 电解液 DN（CHCl3 ¹H NMR 位移换算，本文方法）
descriptors.comparable_note: 同篇同法；作者说明该 DN 不等于量热法 DN，跨文献不可直接比
descriptors.quote: The donor numbers of these electrolytes are 18.3, 14.9, and 13.9, respectively … the DN calculated in our work may not equal the DN tested by conventional calorimetry

descriptors.mapping_note: 测的是装该电解液的 Li-S 电池（dQ/dV）
descriptors.object: 多硫化物溶解行为（热力学代理）
descriptors.comparable_note: 同篇同法；间接指标，作者用它表示溶剂化能力
descriptors.quote: The reduction peaks of (DME)9LiFSI, (DME)3LiFSI-HFE, and (DME)1.6LiFSI-HFE are 2.29, 2.19, and 2.16 V, respectively … the reduction peak in (DME)1.6LiTFSI-HFE is 2.22 V

C1.cathode_material: S/KB（80 wt% S），冻干 + 压实
C1.quote: CR2025 type coin cells were assembled with a 5 mg cm−2 sulfur cathode and a Li metal anode (200 μm) … The sulfur loading of the cathodes was 5 mg cm−2, and the E/S value used in assembling the batteries was 2 μL mg−1 … temperature of Li-S coin cells and pouch cells was 30 °C

comparisons.point: 首次放电（硫利用率 96% vs 20%）
comparisons.author_judgement: 低溶剂化能力避免电解液凝胶化
comparisons.reason_quote: the enlarged polarization in (DME)9LiFSI is closely related to the dissolution of polysulfides and the consequent electrolyte gelation
comparisons.scope_claim: 贫液（作者认为凝胶化只在低 E/S 下发生）
comparisons.quote: a high sulfur utilization of 96% (corresponding to 1600 mAh g−1) can be achieved in E/S = 2 μL mg−1 Li-S coin cells when (DME)1.6LiFSI-HFE (DN = 13.9) is adopted … Figure 6d shows a poor sulfur utilization of 20% (corresponding to 300 mAh g−1) in (DME)9LiFSI (DN = 18.3)

comparisons.author_judgement: LiTFSI 降不下溶剂化能力
comparisons.reason_quote: due to the serious polysulfide network (as shown in Figure S17) in the electrolyte
comparisons.note: 按 DN 判，A（15.9）比 B（18.3）更弱，但结果更差；同时改了盐、浓度、稀释剂
comparisons.quote: the Li-S battery gives poor sulfur utilization in (DME)1.6LiTFSI-HFE (Figure S20a), even lower than that of (DME)9LiFSI

comparisons.author_judgement: LiFSI 更能降低溶剂化能力
comparisons.reason_quote: As shown above that LiTFSI is incapable of depressing the solvation capability of DME, it cannot contribute to a high sulfur utilization
